title: The Penalty Withheld on a Cancelled Vacation Package
content:
The penalty withheld on a cancelled vacation package is worked out from the desk's own cancellation schedule, the money the party had put into the package and the traveller's record with the traveller club, and it is withheld from the party as a whole. This note records how the packages revenue office reaches the figure on a package sold under any of Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products.

## The penalised value and the share taken on it

The penalised value the ladder is taken on is the package price recorded on the package.

The cancellation share taken on the penalised value is the standing share of the desk's cancellation schedule, being 10 per cent. The figure the ladder gives is the penalised value multiplied by that share.

## What is withheld

The figure the ladder gives stands as it is. Nothing is withheld as an administration charge.

The penalty withheld is the figure the ladder gives together with the administration charge withheld. The whole of the figure so reached is withheld, and it is rounded half up to the nearest cent at the end and at no earlier point; no part of the working is rounded before the figure is complete.

## Worked on hypothetical particulars

A package whose recorded price is 5,000.00 USD has a penalised value of 5,000.00 USD. The standing share of the desk's cancellation schedule, 10 per cent, gives a ladder figure of 500.00 USD, which stands as it is. Nothing is withheld as an administration charge, so the figure reached is 500.00 USD, and the whole of it is withheld: 500.00 USD.

A package whose recorded price is 3,333.33 USD gives a ladder figure of 333.333 USD before rounding; the figure is carried at that precision through the working and rounded half up to the nearest cent only at the end, giving 333.33 USD.
